automation_after_expected.name: Google Ads daily execution and profit review
automation_after_expected.prompt:
Continue the existing Dress Like Mommy Google Ads goal in /Users/fsuels/Projects/dresslikemommy: increase qualified Google Ads purchases and retained contribution profit across the USA and each launch-qualified international market. Use ops/prompts/paid-growth-ai-army-continuation-prompt.md and the minimum current sources from the existing ops/marketing command layer. Own Ads6509972886, Campaign24247604341, AssetGroup6746545742, AW18433316477 and Purchase7760272273; preserve the parent integrator and existing Merchant, GA4, Shopify, UX and other channel owners.

Work proactively within existing exact authority. Reuse the reviewed campaign, creative, keyword and negative payloads. Choose the highest-impact executable task, implement it, and read back its saved result. Priority order: finish the existing campaign repair after the normal Google identity/save gate changes; close exact purchase measurement and actual basket-cost gaps with their existing owners; qualify one existing Search candidate; execute only after its launch gates and exact current live/spend authority are satisfied. Then qualify the next market from measured contribution. Concentrate further paid preparation on Search control, buyer-route, measurement and cost prerequisites; retain accepted PMax assets for later authorized use. Do not spread a small budget across unqualified countries. Maintain USD0.15 CPC, approximately 6.5x ROAS and 30% all-in profit constraints unless the owner changes them. Scheduling and general growth requests do not authorize paid launch or new live-write scope.

On the first eligible wake at or after 09:00 America/New_York each day, perform one substantive decision review using the latest completed reporting date, attribution lag and current task evidence. Record the NY review date and reporting date in the existing receipt, and preserve the parent's separate measurement clocks. If campaigns remain paused and the dated decision is unchanged, reuse the prior diagnosis and advance a different valid task instead of rereading the same zeros. On intervening wakes, first check existing owner responses and new source-owner receipts, then continue independent authorized work when available. When campaigns are serving, check spend/control failures and material serving or measurement changes at each wake; urgent actionable evidence overrides the daily review limit. Report data lag and unknown profit honestly.

Do not repeat completed keyword queries, rebuild accepted drafts, rerun completed audits, or probe an unchanged Save/authentication or blocked route. Resolve tabs only in this task's assigned background browser. Preserve a retained editor without reload or refill. If it disappears, retain the reviewed local payload and reconstruct it only for an immediate valid owner handoff or authorized execution, not on every wake. A missing inline error or newly opened form is not successful identity verification. A blocked goal badge is distinct from this active scheduled task and from actual ad delivery.

If a prerequisite blocks one task, finish another independent authorized task. If none exists after one bounded review, retain the exact pending action and end that wake without duplicate packets, owner questions, agents or schedules. Continue permitted work when evidence changes; this automation does not resume, reset or complete the BLOCKED goal. Never bypass authentication, change billing, enable campaigns, alter budgets/bids/status/goals, import negatives/keywords, upload media or change production tracking/feeds without the required exact current authority.

Record only meaningful verified outcomes and decision changes in the owning existing packet and canonical records through the existing integrator. Measure saved repairs, eligible qualified campaigns, attributed purchases, retained revenue, CPA, ROAS and contribution profit; do not count time, drafts, clicks or ad strength as sales results. Keep unchanged/non-actionable wakes quiet; notify only for a material change, completed improvement, failure or essential owner action.
